kind: independent design review; not an active plan
status: ready for scoped implementation; production untouched; proposed cases not yet executed

scope.firstSlice: Exact selection feedback on already supported UTF-8 plain text and Markdown source, including current bounded large-file block. No file editing, no new Agent request or permission.
scope.remaining: PDF regions, Office locations, image regions, cross-unloaded-block selection and P22 real Agent rework remain separate; all122 original conditions remain.

confirmedSourceGap.fact: Disk text opinions always reset selection=null and scope=file; disk version tuple already exists at591.
Actual bounded text is a plain pre; no selection callback carries the displayed block owner.
Existing before/after selection explicitly describes reported tool content, not disk coordinates; do not reuse it with misleading before/after labels.
Strict saved anchor parser currently accepts only pdf-page; new kind must extend the union and exhaustive rendering.

persistedShapeProposal.startLine: one-based logical line of first selected token
persistedShapeProposal.endLine: one-based logical line containing last selected token

coordinateContract.identity: Parent saved feedback path/contentId already contains resolved path, opaque disk version and full SHA. A range never changes that tuple. No source body or global selection ledger stored.
coordinateContract.units: Convert exact displayed DOM text UTF-16 offsets using UTF-8 encoding of source prefixes, then add proven block.byteStart. Never use JS string.length as bytes or normalize input. Walk original DOM Text nodes and their offsets; never use selection.toString(), innerText or text.indexOf(selection), which cannot distinguish repeated text and may normalize layout.
coordinateContract.lineRules: CRLF counts once; isolated CR/LF count once; BOM consumes3 UTF-8 bytes but no line break. A trailing selected newline belongs to its preceding line; no extra empty end line.
coordinateContract.boundaries: Endpoints may not split a surrogate pair or CRLF. Empty/multiple/disjoint/outside-container ranges rejected. Reverse drag is normalized to the same ordered source range. Combining-character boundaries are preserved as selected; do not normalize graphemes.
coordinateContract.largeFile: Use actual returned block text, byteStart and startLine, never requested blockIndex or a parent initial block after child navigation. A mid-line block does not start at byte0 or a new logical line. Selection is limited to current loaded block; no full-file reread or fabricated missing bytes merely to expand selection. Existing receipts do not provide the absolute column prefix for a startsMidLine block; do not display column=1 or claim an absolute column.
coordinateContract.smallText: Use original UTF-8 text receipt unchanged. Rendered Markdown/HTML DOM is not source-coordinate evidence; explicit source mode uses exact text and retains existing rendered mode.

evidenceAndTrust.backendProof: read_text uses capture_expected then UTF-8 decode (file_delivery.rs:370); read_text_block performs full stream::expected before returning calculated range/lines (text_blocks.rs:186). stream::expected reopens, checks final path/root/leaf and compares full SHA/version. Existing file_read_check admission/pending behavior remains.
evidenceAndTrust.liveFactory: Construct a new anchor only from the current active successfully-read source object plus a DOM Range entirely inside its exact text surface. Require textContent===source.text, valid endpoints, source byte length consistency, recomputed range/line bounds and exact current owner at explicit confirmation. Snapshot/file fields alone are not a certificate.
evidenceAndTrust.structuralParserIsNotProof: parseTextBlock and parseFeedbackAnchor validate shape/consistency, not provenance. JSON with matching path/hash can be manufactured. Do not export a path+numbers-to-verified-anchor shortcut or let IPC/tool metadata bypass actual read/display ownership.
evidenceAndTrust.coldRestore: Strictly parse and preserve a historical anchor; initialize any live verification flag to false and do not serialize it. Display and transfer as a previously selected position, not current-disk or newly checked proof. Unknown fields/versions reject the whole unsent snapshot under existing protection, never drop fields and rewrite.
evidenceAndTrust.revalidate: To claim position currently rechecked, explicitly read the same full version through existing backend, obtain the block containing the range (or whole small text), then recompute endpoints/lines against those actual bytes. SamePreviewFile or matching digest strings alone are insufficient; missing/changed/unavailable leaves history intact and unverified. Location mismatch must not silently clamp a feedback range.
evidenceAndTrust.take: Historical opinions remain usable: clearly mark historical position and original digest; ask downstream reader to verify the original version. Adding to composer does not assert current validity or send a request.
evidenceAndTrust.securityLimit: No tamper-evident signature or authentic proof of a past human selection is promised. A malicious local DB edit can alter historical draft metadata; current validity must come from a fresh read. Do not treat a forged saved anchor as an access grant, current read proof or native receipt.

minimalChanges.role: Pure source-offset conversion and validation; separate historical parser and live-source factory/revalidation, fixed coordinate rules.
Discriminated anchor union, exhaustive rendering and strict snapshot parse. Keep same unsentWork.v1 container, original PDF/tool feedback compatibility, existing one-snapshot take.

minimalChanges.path: new shared plain-source selection component/hook; src/components/TextBlockPreview.tsx
minimalChanges.role: Current displayed block owns the callback; pointer and keyboard selections both work. Retire candidates when block/source/active/read state changes.

Explicit selected target/whole-file target and source mode. Existing opinion does not retarget on drag/flip/refresh; only deliberate target action updates it. Parent checks exact callback ownership again, preserves all old versions.

minimalChanges.path: src/runtime/file_delivery.ts or new small-text receipt validator (only if shared factory requires it)
minimalChanges.role: Validate readText shape, exact file identity, scalar-valid text and UTF-8 byte count before using it for coordinates; this validation still does not replace actual backend provenance.

backendResponsibility.expectedProductionChange: None required for the minimum slice if current read receipts are reused and cold positions are explicitly historical until reread. Keep existing full-stream/OS read slot/path/version authority; do not introduce a persisted proof token or new ledger.
backendResponsibility.tests: Real temp-file receipt for the oracle samples, equality with expected UTF-8 slices and global lines; forged VerifiedFile metadata/changed file must be rejected by existing expected-version read. Reuse/extend scoped tests only if current coverage is missing.
backendResponsibility.conditional: If UI promises current verification for a saved range without loading its containing source, a dedicated backend full-version/range verifier is necessary. Do not silently make that stronger promise in this slice.

takeAndFailureRules: Append exactly once to original composer; preserve its existing text, attachments, queue-edit/pending fields, other opinions and queues. Remove only exact feedback key in the same persisted snapshot.
Settings failure leaves combined composer in memory and original disk opinion recoverable; show unsaved state, never claim disk save or auto-send.
Repeated click after take returns false/no duplicate. File content and backend file commands remain untouched.
validationBoundary: Read-only source inspection plus independently asserted Python UTF-8 literal oracles. No new production tests, browser/native UI, Agent or user data operations executed in this design task.

independentBackendCheck.result: Existing complete UTF-8 receipts preserve BOM and newlines, and full-file verified blocks include global byte and line ranges without splitting scalars/CRLF. No Rust production change needed for this slice. Existing real Rust text-block wire fixtures may supply the cross-language test input.
independentBackendCheck.boundary: Read-only source review, not a new backend test execution or a live-selection implementation result.
